rationale: The bid-ask spread of 143 bps creates an immediate structural disadvantage that makes any intraday edge extremely difficult to capture — the spread alone consumes a significant portion of any realistic move. Price is at 95% of today's range near the session high with only 98 minutes remaining, offering poor risk/reward for a long (chasing extended move) and dangerous momentum for a short. The combination of extreme spread, position near the high, and limited time remaining makes this an unfavorable entry in either direction.
